title: O Jogo Que Para de Crescer
historicalTitle: O Jogo Que Para de Crescer
summary: In the fictional Kairos continuity, Riot announces a post-2027 shift away from new League champions and a larger 2027 Tier 1 and Tier 2 international ecosystem.
keyEvents: After 2027 League will stop releasing new champions; already-in-production final champions may release during 2027.
League development shifts to reworks, visual and gameplay updates, map evolution, items, objectives, runes, systems, seasonal mechanics, modes, and balance; this is not maintenance mode.
The 2027 Tier 1 calendar includes First Stand, Crossroads Cup, MSI, Rift Masters, Worlds, and Demacia Cup Global.
Tier 2 adds Crossroads Challengers and Rift Masters Challengers; WSCI remains the leading global Tier 2 event.
Crossroads uses 16 teams, with LCK/LPL/LEC/LCS three each and LCP/CBLOL two each; Rift Masters uses 12 teams, two from each region.
Global Circuit Points connect regional and international performance; exact point tables remain TBD.
No Kairos team has qualified for any new event.
